detail: Iisalo plays at a very high pace

sources.text: Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace, uses short five-minute stints, and keeps minutes down.
sources.quote: You play 5 minutes, you come out and you go hard in that time and we play extremely high pace
